versions.changelog:
Initial release of permark skill providing integration with PerMark desktop Markdown IDE:

- Enables inspection of the current document, selection, and context the developer is viewing.
- Supports searching tagged specifications and sections across project Markdown files.
- Allows listing and resolving inline passage review comments.
- Provides access to user-shared notes and drafts.
- Facilitates efficient document navigation, context resolution, and feedback workflows.
